description: This file declares the CrosvmManager class, which manages the lifecycle of a guest VM using crosvm within the cuttlefish project. It includes method declarations for configuration and startup of the VM, and references external classes and utilities related to VM management.

classes.name: CrosvmManager
classes.description: A class that manages crosvm-based virtual machines within the cuttlefish VM management framework.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the crosvm manager.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current environment supports crosvm.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for the VM based on the provided instance configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot devices for the VM based on the provided instance configuration.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the commands necessary to start the VM.

methods.name: WaitForRestoreComplete
methods.description: Waits for the VM restore process to complete.
